dct_title_s: Geological sketch map of Western Australia : based on the work of the Geological Survey, 1919
dct_alternative_sm: Geological sketch map of Western Australia : based on the work of the Geological Survey, 1919
dct_description_sm: Geological map of W.A. showing minerals, goldfields and other mining district boundaries, divisional boundaries and explorer's routes. Relief by hachures and spot heights.
